basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software engineer from Melbourne, Australia, with a deep-seated love for technology and the digital world. My interests include blockchain technology, digital currencies, and the ever-evolving field of artificial intelligence. I spend my evenings and weekends exploring new tech trends and discussing them on various forums. When I'm not working or online, I enjoy hiking and photography. Currently single, I prefer to keep my relationships casual and fun. My typical online hours are late at night, once I've finished my day job.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have spent the last decade working in the tech industry, specializing in software development and blockchain solutions. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and self-taught insights gained from countless hours of online research and community engagement.
